[[Category:Senate]] [[Category:Senate Sessions]] [[Category:384YE Summer]]
==Overview==
The [[Senate]] governs the Empire, and its authority extends to all areas of Imperial life not already covered by the other houses of government. Each summit the [[senator|senators]] meet several times to deliberate and vote on the [[Senate motion|motions]] they have raised. 

After the summit the civil service enact those motions, and ensure a public record of each is made available to the citizens of the Empire. This page lists all the motions raised during the summit, along with the [[Senate announcement|announcements]] made by citizens with [[Imperial title|Imperial titles]]. In each case, the motion and its effects are summarised including the wording; who proposed and seconded it; whether it passed or not; whether any funds were disbursed to support it; and what the outcome of the motion will be.

Many motions (especially the [[commission|commissions]]) also have a ''Further Details'' section that provides a link to a wiki page dealing specifically with that motion in more detail, any commentary from the [[Scrutiny|Constitutional Court]], progress on commissions, or expanded information about the outcome of the motion.

* Imperial treasury during this season was announced by the civil service at 205 thrones and 6 crowns.
* The following has been donated to the Imperial treasury:
** 28 thrones donated to the treasury by '''Magdalena Teyhard von Holberg''' after the Summer Solstice 384YE
** 10 thrones donated to the treasury by '''William Lowther''' after the Summer Solstice 384YE

==Administrative Motions==
Two administrative motions raised by the Constitutional Court were presented during the Summer Solstice.
===Amend Churnspire Adjutor===
*'''Motion:''' To confirm the method for the Churnspire Adjutor as being appointed by the Senate.
* '''Raised by:''' Speaker for the Senate
* '''Passed'''
* '''Outcome:''' The work has been done to complete this commission. If the senate passes this motion the Churnspire Adjutor will be available to be elected at the upcoming summit, if they don't then the commission will be inactive.
===Cede Spiral Spy Network===
*'''Motion:''' Cede spiral spy network to Sung'''.
*'''Raised by:''' Speaker for the Senate
* '''Passed'''

==Senate Motions==
===Allocate Pride of Ikka's Tears===
* '''Motion:''' To re-allocate the Pride of Ikka's Tears, located in the Suaq Fount, of the Wintermark territory of Sermersuaq, to the nation of Wintermark. Once one of two national seats, it was lost to the Empire in War with the Jotun. The Brilliant Shore, having been relinquished by Wintermarkers with Skarsind in Summer 380YE. This small mithril mine would represent Wintermark's sole national bourse seat. Proposed: [[Hahnmark#Recent_Senate_Elections|Hahnmark]], Seconded: [[Kallavesi#Recent_Senate_Elections|Kallavesi]].
* '''Passed'''
* '''Outcome:''' Allocates [[Pride of Ikka's Tears]] as a [[Wintermark]] national seat.
* '''Further Details:''' See also [[#Assign Sermersuaq|Assign Sermersuaq]]
===Amend Liberty Pact===
* '''Motion:''' To amend the Liberty Pact to include the following clauses: Signatory nations will apply a trade embargo to the Principalities of Jarm. All signatory nations to apply free trade to other signatory nations. As agreed during the Spring 384YE Liberty Pact summit. Proposed: [[Reikos#Recent_Senate_Elections|Reikos]], Seconded: [[Kahraman#Recent_Senate_Elections|Kahraman]].
* '''Passed'''
* '''Outcome:''' Amends the Liberty Pact, adding [[Voice_of_Liberty#Spring_384YE_Amendments|two additional clauses]].

===Amend Warmage===
* '''Motion:''' To amend the responsibilities of Imperial Warmage to remove the responsibility to organise the casting of rituals at the behest of the Military Council. Proposed: [[Bastion#Recent_Senate_Elections|Bastion]], Seconded: [[Miaren#Recent_Senate_Elections|Miaren]].
* '''Passed'''
* '''Outcome:''' The responsibilities of the [[Warmage]] have been amended to remove the responsibility for "''helping to arrange magical assistance for the armies of the Empire''."

===Appraise Architectural University in Temeschwar===
* '''Motion:''' A motion to appraise an opportunity to construct an Architectural University in Temeschwar that would provide the Empire with at least one additional build slot. The appointed prognosticator is Graciana i Lopez i Guerra. Proposed: [[Karsk#Recent_Senate_Elections|Karsk]], Seconded: [[Miekarova#Recent_Senate_Elections|Miekarova]].
* '''Passed'''
* '''Outcome:''' An [[appraisal]] will be presented before the Autumn Equinox 384YE.

===Appraise effects of a non human Throne===

* '''Failed'''
===Assign Sermersuaq===
* '''Motion:''' To re-assign the Imperial territory of Sermersuaq to the nation of Wintermark. Proposed: [[Kallavesi#Recent_Senate_Elections|Kallavesi]], Seconded: [[Hahnmark#Recent_Senate_Elections|Hahnmark]].
* '''Passed'''
* '''Outcome:''' Assigns the territory to Wintermark.
* '''Further Details:''' See also [[#Allocate Pride of Ikka's Tears|Allocate Pride of Ikka's Tears]]
===Create Archivist of the Echoing Obelisk===
* '''Motion:''' To create the title of Archivist of the Echoing Obelisk and give permission to the Keepers of the Silent Obelisks to add the blank-faced stone. The Archivist will be responsible for collecting and recording the names of Imperial citizens who fall in our wars who do not attend Anvil but deserve to be remembered with equal virtue. They will have the right to address the <s>highborn at the end of the Day of the Dead procession. They will also have to power to address the Senate</s> to speak on behalf of those who have fallen in the name of Imperial Destiny once per summit should they feel moved to do so. The position will be appointed by the Highguard National Assembly and would be held for a year.  Proposed: [[Madruga#Recent_Senate_Elections|Madruga]], Seconded: [[Segura#Recent_Senate_Elections|Segura]].
* '''Passed'''
* '''Outcome:''' Creates the title of [[Archivist of the Echoing Obelisk]]. This opportunity is detailed in the '''[[Daughters_of_the_Empire#Archivist_of_the_Blank_Book|Daughters of the Empire]]''' wind of fortune.
* '''Further Details:''' As proposed in the opportunity, the Archivist also has a particular responsibility during the [[Highguard_culture_and_customs#Day_of_the_Dead|Day of the Dead]] celebrations; to mark the end of the grand procession at Anvil by calling on all present to spend a moment thinking on the nature of virtue, and what a terrible thing it is to be forgotten.

===Create Imperial Administrator===
* '''Motion:''' To create the title Imperial Administrator. This role to support the bodies of state in efficient and effective diplomatic, trading, and military efforts. The title will receive a stipend of 5 Thrones per season, and have the power of address to the Senate once per season. To be elected by a majority vote of the Senate, and revocable by the General Assembly. Proposed: [[Conscience of the Senate#Recent_Senate_Elections|Conscience of the Senate]], Seconded: [[Bastion#Recent_Senate_Elections|Bastion]].
* '''Passed'''
* '''Outcome:''' Creates Imperial title of [[Imperial Administrator]]

===Create Imperial Warcaster===
* '''Motion:''' To create the title of Imperial Warcaster to coordinate the arrangement of magical assistance for the armies of the Empire and is granted one military council address and one free conclave address per summit. To be appointed by the Military Council. Proposed: [[Ossium#Recent_Senate_Elections|Ossium]], Seconded: [[Necropolis#Recent_Senate_Elections|Necropolis]].
* '''Passed'''
* '''Outcome:''' Creates the title of [[Imperial Warcaster]]

===Create Spiral Envoy===
* '''Motion:''' Create the position of the Spiral Envoy to trade money for ingots (especially tempest jade) and white granite for mithril at a maximum of ten per season. To be elected by Urizen senators. Proposed: [[Redoubt#Recent_Senate_Elections|Redoubt]], Seconded: [[Morrow#Recent_Senate_Elections|Morrow]].
* '''Passed'''
* '''Outcome:''' Intended to create the Imperial title of [[Spiral Envoy]] detailed in the '''[[Pebbles_drawn_from_a_heap#The_Spiral_Envoy|Pebbles drawn from a heap]]''' wind of fortune.
* '''Further Details:''' This title cannot be appointed by the Senators of Urizen. As suggested by the Civil Service, the [[New_Imperial_titles#Well_Worn_Paths|well worn path]] would be to appoint it annually by the [[Tally of the Votes]] (a vote by Urizen mana site owners). While the title trades [[white granite]] for [[mithril]] rather than purchasing it directly, the Constitution Court has decided to err on the side of caution. An administrative motion has been raised to amend the appointment method.

===Create Sodality===
* '''Motion:''' To create a sodality to recognise and collectivise existing Imperial groups dedicated to the elevation of lineage issues in the Empire. This will create the Imperial title of "Chairperson for the Imperial Lineage Caucus" who will have the right to address the Senate on issues raised amongst the sodality. This title will be appointed by the Senate. Proposed: [[Volodmartz#Recent_Senate_Elections|Volodmartz]], Seconded: [[Ossium#Recent_Senate_Elections|Ossium]].
* '''Passed'''
* '''Outcome:''' This motion is the subject of additional [[scrutiny]].
* '''Further Details:'''
===Declaration of Military Neutrality===
* '''Motion:''' We declare that in the likely upcoming conflict between Jarm and the Commonwealth the Empire will remain militarily neutral unless we are attacked or directly forced into taking action.  Proposed: [[Semmerholm#Recent_Senate_Elections|Semmerholm]], Seconded: [[Madruga#Recent_Senate_Elections|Madruga]].
* '''Passed'''
* '''Outcome:''' This declaration related to the ultimatum delivered by the [[Principalities of Jarm]] in the '''[[What%27s_good_for_me#Extended_Ultimatuum|What's good for me]]''' wind of fortune.
* '''Further Details:''' While it is understood that this declaration does not have legal authority - a motion cannot bind the hands of a future senate - it acknowledges a moral authority. There may be significant political repercussions if a future Senate chooses to disregard this commitment without addressing it.

===Reassure Great Forest Orcs===
* '''Motion:''' The Empire wishes to reassure the Great Forest Orcs of our intention to concede the Heart of Peytaht to them when the Barrens are secured under Imperial control, as per article VI of the peace treaty signed Summer 381YE Proposed: [[Weirwater#Recent_Senate_Elections|Weirwater]], Seconded: [[Therunin#Recent_Senate_Elections|Therunin]].
* '''Passed'''
* '''Outcome:''' Further information can be found in the '''[[The_day_writes_the_words#Disposition_of_the_Spoils|The day writes the words]]''' wind of fortune
* '''Further Details:''' The [[Great Forest Orcs]] understand that a motion cannot bind the hands of a future Senate, and that this declaration does not have legal authority. However they also appreciate that it acknowledges a moral authority. There may be significant political consequences if a future Senate chooses to disregard this commitment without addressing it. This motion is sufficient to secure the benefits outlined in the '''[[Make_a_deal#Dream_of_the_Future|Make a deal]]''' wind of fortune.

==Commissions (Senate)==
The Senate can commission nine projects during the course of a single summit. Certain [[Imperial title|Imperial titles]] such as the [[Imperial Spymaster]], [[Imperial Master of Works]], and [[Arcane Architect]] have the ability to [[Senate announcement|announce]] commissions without a Senate vote.
===Construct Ratibor's Gate Shrine===
* '''Motion:''' Consecrate Ratibor's Gate and construct an inspirational tomb in Temeschwar, costing 20 wains of white granite and 5 Thrones, plus one dose of true liao. This will create the title "Watcher of Ratibor's Torch", to be appointed by the League National Assembly. Proposed: [[Temeschwar#Recent_Senate_Elections|Temeschwar]]. Seconded: [[Casinea#Recent_Senate_Elections|Casinea]].
* '''Passed'''
* '''Outcome:''' Creates a [[inspirational location|memorial]] in Temeschwar, along with the title of [[Watcher of Ratibor's Torch]].
* '''Further Details''': [[Construct Ratibor's Gate Shrine|Here]].

This creates the title "Legate of the Imperial Auxiliaries" with the power to address Military Council, to be elected by Military Council. This position has the responsibility to support the Imperial Auxiliaries in aiding the Field Marshall with communicating on major conjunctions through the sentinel gate. Revocable by the General and the Assembly of Nine. Proposed: [[Necropolis#Recent_Senate_Elections|Necropolis]]. Seconded: [[Holberg#Recent_Senate_Elections|Holberg]].

* '''Outcome:''' Creates a sinecure and the title of [[Legate of the Imperial Auxiliaries]]
* '''Further Details:''' [[Construct Garden of Imperial Auxiliaries|Here]].

<!--
The Crimson Sutannir 

On the Eastern side of The Jade Range there lies an area where the crystal clear waters flow down from the mountains to the warm and sandy soil of Torres. Here reside a group of Freeborn who cultivate Alkonet, it's thick, fleshy red-maroon roots used as a dyestuff soluble in alcohol, ether, and the oils, but is insoluble in water. It is used to give colour to wines and alcoholic tinctures, to vegetable oils, and to varnishes.

Powdered and mixed with oil, the alkanet root is used as a wood stain. When mixed into an oily environment, it imparts a crimson colour to the oil, which when applied to a wood, moves the wood colour towards dark-red-brown rosewood, and accentuates the grain of the wood, the Freeborn use this oil to care for their wooden musical instruments, most notably their drums.  

As is the way of the Freeborn,  they celebrate The Way, rather than preach it. Their celebrations involve feasting and dancing to the rhythms provided by the drummers - their hands stained bright Crimson by the oils they use.

In 384 YE, Ahraz i Guerra commissioned an amphitheatre of white granite to be raised at the base of the mountain, to provide shelter during the performances and the enhance music of the Freeborn. Through a series of chambers and covered walkways, the low frequencies of the drums are enhanced before exiting through large, trumpet-shaped windows to carry the sounds of Freeborn celebrating their Faith far across the grasslands. The beats act as a call to all Freeborn in the area to come join the festivities and celebrate their faith
-->
